info.title: eReqTool
info.description: A CLI tool for managing AU FHIR eRequesting resources with in a target FHIR server.

commands.name: diagnosticorder
commands.description: Operations against a single Diagnostic Order

commands.name: read
commands.description: Display a summary of a Diagnostic Order by group identifier

options.name: --group-id
options.description: The Task.groupIdentifier fhir query value to filter by (Required)

options.name: --owner-id
options.description: The Task.owner.identifier fhir query value to filter by

commands.name: init
commands.description: Initialize FhirRepositorySettings.json in the current working directory

options.name: --service-base-url
options.description: The FHIR server base URL (e.g. https://fhir.example.com/fhir)

options.name: --auth-type
options.description: Authentication type: none, oauth2, apikey, basic

commands.name: servicerequest
commands.description: Operations against a FHIR ServiceRequest Resources

commands.name: servicerequest
commands.description: HTTP GET a FHIR Task resource by group identifier

options.name: --group-id
options.description: The Task.groupIdentifier fhir query value to filter by

options.name: --owner-id
options.description: The Task.owner.identifier fhir query value to filter by

commands.name: task
commands.description: Operations against a FHIR Task Resources

commands.name: read
commands.description: HTTP GET (Read) of a FHIR Task resources by group-identifier

options.name: --group-id
options.description: The Task.groupIdentifier fhir query value to filter by (Required)

options.name: --owner-id
options.description: The Task.owner.identifier fhir query value to filter by

commands.name: status-update
commands.description: Updates the FHIR Task status in a Transaction Bundle, by group-identifier and optional owner.identifier

options.name: --group-id
options.description: The Task.groupIdentifier fhir query value to filter by (Required)

options.name: --owner-id
options.description: The Task.owner.identifier fhir query value to filter by

options.name: --status
options.description: The FHIR Task.status to set. Must be one of: requested|received|accepted|in-progress|ready|completed|failed|cancelled|rejected|on-hold|draft (Required)

options.name: --force
options.description: Skips user confirmation prompts for a non interaction workflow
